headline: The AGI Boys rise from 470th to 42nd on ARC-3

sections.text: The AGI Boys gained 4.79 points to reach 35.35, moving from 470th to 42nd on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The team is now 42nd, with the last of 18 gold places at 18th and 38.20.
